prompt_text:
Task: Static Image and Visual Understanding

Write code that checks an image for unsafe or policy-sensitive visual content using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure AI Vision:
  Service: Azure AI Vision
  SDK: azure-ai-vision-imageanalysis / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: analyze
  Setup hints: AZURE_VISION_ENDPOINT, AZURE_VISION_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/computer-vision/overview-image-analysis

Option 2 — Google Cloud Vision:
  Service: Cloud Vision
  SDK: google-cloud-vision
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: label_detection, text_detection
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vision/docs

Option 3 — Clarifai:
  Service: Clarifai Image Recognition
  SDK: clarifai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: predict
  Setup hints: CLARIFAI_PAT
  Official docs: https://docs.clarifai.com/api-guide/predict/images

Option 4 — Amazon Rekognition:
  Service: Amazon Rekognition
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_labels, detect_text
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Qwen-VL / Alibaba visual understanding:
  Service: DashScope multimodal vision
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: MultiModalConversation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-vl-api

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import base64
import io
import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError
from PIL import Image


def _load_image_bytes(image_input: Any) -> bytes:
    if isinstance(image_input, bytes):
        return image_input

    if isinstance(image_input, str):
        if os.path.isfile(image_input):
            with open(image_input, "rb") as f:
                return f.read()
        if image_input.startswith("data:image/"):
            header, _, payload = image_input.partition(",")
            if not payload:
                raise ValueError("Invalid data URI image input.")
            return base64.b64decode(payload)
        try:
            return base64.b64decode(image_input, validate=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ValueError("image_input must be a file path, bytes, or base64-encoded string.") from exc

    raise TypeError("image_input must be bytes or str.")


def check_image_for_unsafe_content(image_input: Any, region_name: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Checks an image for unsafe or policy-sensitive visual content using Amazon Rekognition.

    Returns a dictionary with:
      - unsafe: bool
      - risk_level: str
      - labels: list
      - text: list
      - details: dict
    """
    image_bytes = _load_image_bytes(image_input)

    # Validate/normalize image format for more predictable API behavior.
    try:
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes)) as im:
            fmt = (im.format or "").upper()
            if fmt not in {"JPEG", "JPG", "PNG"}:
                # Rekognition supports JPEG and PNG. Keep the original bytes if already valid.
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    rekognition = boto3.client("rekognition", region_name=region_name)

    try:
        label_resp = rekognition.detect_labels(
            Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
            MaxLabels=50,
            MinConfidence=60.0,
        )
        text_resp = rekognition.detect_text(
            Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
        )
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Amazon Rekognition request failed: {exc}") from exc

    labels = [
        {
            "name": label.get("Name"),
            "confidence": float(label.get("Confidence", 0.0)),
            "parents": [p.get("Name") for p in label.get("Parents", []) if p.get("Name")],
        }
        for label in label_resp.get("Labels", [])
    ]

    text_detections = text_resp.get("TextDetections", [])
    text = [
        {
            "type": item.get("Type"),
            "detected_text": item.get("DetectedText"),
            "confidence": float(item.get("Confidence", 0.0)),
        }
        for item in text_detections
        if item.get("DetectedText")
    ]

    label_names = {l["name"].lower() for l in labels if l.get("name")}
    all_text = " ".join(t["detected_text"] for t in text if t.get("detected_text")).lower()

    unsafe_signals = []

    sensitive_label_map = {
        "weapon",
        "gun",
        "pistol",
        "rifle",
        "knife",
        "blade",
        "bomb",
        "explosive",
        "explosion",
        "firearm",
        "ammunition",
        "drug",
        "cocaine",
        "heroin",
        "marijuana",
        "alcohol",
        "blood",
        "injury",
        "wound",
        "corpse",
        "dead body",
        "nude",
        "nudity",
        "explicit nudity",
        "sexual activity",
        "sex toy",
        "hate symbol",
        "swastika",
    }

    for name in label_names:
        if name in sensitive_label_map:
            unsafe_signals.append(f"label:{name}")

    text_sensitive_keywords = [
        "kill",
        "suicide",
        "bomb",
        "attack",
        "terror",
        "drugs",
        "weapon",
        "porn",
        "nude",
        "sex",
        "hate",
        "racial slur",
    ]
    for kw in text_sensitive_keywords:
        if kw in all_text:
            unsafe_signals.append(f"text:{kw}")

    unsafe = len(unsafe_signals) > 0

    if unsafe:
        risk_level = "high"
    else:
        max_conf = max((l["confidence"] for l in labels), default=0.0)
        if max_conf >= 85.0:
            risk_level = "low"
        else:
            risk_level = "unknown"

    return {
        "unsafe": unsafe,
        "risk_level": risk_level,
        "labels": labels,
        "text": text,
        "details": {
            "unsafe_signals": unsafe_signals,
            "provider": "amazon-rekognition",
            "label_response_metadata": label_resp.get("ResponseMetadata", {}),
            "text_response_metadata": text_resp.get("ResponseMetadata", {}),
        },
    }
